comments.author: tomhoward
comments.story: A sweary, ranty YouTuber who's become an isolation cooking sensation
comments.text: From reading the comments I can see it's not exactly obvious what to look for if you're interested to explore beyond what's embedded in the article, so here's a bit of a guide... - How To Make Quarantine Sauce: [LINK] That's the one that kicked the whole thing off, back in Mid March when panic buying cleared the shelves of frozen & packet food. The others are: Quarantine Spirit Risotto: [LINK] - Sin Bin Soup: [LINK] - End of Days Bolognese: [VIDEO] - The Crowd Goes Mild Curry: [LINK] - Wham Bam Thank You Lamb: [LINK] And if you're curious about the kinds of videos he was making before this foray into cooking: - The Overpriced Boat Show Review: [LINK] - Summernats What I Reckon (at a car festival in which a major component is hotted up old cars doing burnouts): [LINK]
